summary: COMM 2016-COR1 Mortgage Trust filed an 8-K reporting that, effective October 14, 2026, Torchlight Loan Services, LLC replaced CWCapital Asset Management LLC as special servicer for the Prudential Plaza mortgage loan and related pari passu and subordinate notes, a non-serviced loan combination governed by the COMM 2015-CCRE26 pooling and servicing agreement. Torchlight was appointed at the direction of CMBS CCR, LLC, the directing holder. No price, stake, premium, or board recommendation is stated. This is a routine CMBS servicing transfer, not a special situation; watch for any future special-servicing transfer as a credit signal.
